# Wedeo

Rust media toolkit with native and WebAssembly entry points.

- README.md — build instructions, bundled samples, browser studio, and CLI examples
- crates/wedeo/src/lib.rs — public API, feature-gated modules, and registry construction
- bins/wedeo-cli/ — native CLI and MCP entry points
- bins/wedeo-wasm/ and web/ — WebAssembly exports and browser studio
- codecs/, formats/, adapters/ — built-in implementations and external codec adapters
- tests/wedeo-oracle/ — differential tests and reference helpers
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — architectural design
- DIVERGENCES.md — known differences from FFmpeg
- CONTRIBUTING.md and CLAUDE.md — contribution and implementation guidance
- docs/history/ — earlier progress reports and design notes
